title: UC4 loan 4 whole repayment schedule: the three observed principal components sum to the disbursed principal and amortize to zero (Tier-D MNT replay)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the WHOLE repayment schedule of UC4 loan 4 from the Tier-D MNT replay of LoanRepaymentSchedule.feature (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits; product LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INTEREST_DECL_BAL_SARP_EMI_360_30_INT_RECALC_DAILY_MULTIDISB_PARTIAL_PERIOD). request.schedule_amortization transcribes repaymentSchedule.totalPrincipalDisbursed 1200.00 -> "120000" minor units and the three observed repayment-period principalDue values 396.62,399.69,403.69 -> 39662,39969,40369. The disbursement row(s) carry no principalDue and are NOT components, exactly as period 0 is excluded on the single-disbursement captures. expect.principal_sum_minor and expect.final_principal_balance_minor are TRANSCRIPTIONS, not recomputations: the components sum to 120000 = the disbursed principal, and the final period's principalLoanBalanceOutstanding is 0.0, so the final balance is "0". Loan 4 is a two-tranche MULTI-DISBURSEMENT loan: its schedule opens with two disbursement rows, 1000.00 on 2025-01-01 and 200.00 on 2025-01-15; totalPrincipalDisbursed 1200.00 is the observed scalar this seam admits and the tranche structure itself is not representable here. Nothing was computed by this promotion.
